title: DuraShare
description: A BIP39 threshold-backup specification using Shamir sharing over GF(2053), with offline software and a manual fallback. Its per-share audit checks geographically distributed backup artifacts before recovery without reconstructing the mnemonic.

resources.title: DuraShare Specification and Reference Implementations
resources.notes: Primary protocol, manual/software specifications, and test vectors. The project states that reference implementations have not been independently audited and should not be used with real funds. The BIP39 passphrase requires a separate backup.
